text_en: Are we beginning to commend ourselves again? Surely we do not need, as some do, letters of recommendation to you or from you, do we?
text_cn: 我们岂又开始举荐我们自己吗？或者，难道我们也应像某些人一般，需要给你们递上荐书，或由你们写荐书吗？

text_en: You yourselves are our letter, written on our hearts, to be known and read by all;
text_cn: 你们就是我们的荐书，是写在我们心上，为众人所共知共读的，

text_en: and you show that you are a letter of Christ, prepared by us, written not with ink but with the Spirit of the living God, not on tablets of stone but on tablets of human hearts.
text_cn: 因为明显地，你们就是我们供职所写的基督的书信：不是用墨水写的，而是以生活的天主圣神；不是写在石版上，而是在血肉的心版上。

text_en: Such is the confidence that we have through Christ toward God.
text_cn: 我们藉着基督在天主前才敢这样自信，

text_en: Not that we are competent of ourselves to claim anything as coming from us; our competence is from God,
text_cn: 但这并不是说：我们凭自己能够承担什么事，好似出于自己一般；而是说：我们所以够资格，是出于天主，

text_en: who has made us competent to be ministers of a new covenant, not of letter but of spirit; for the letter kills, but the Spirit gives life.
text_cn: 并且是他使我们能够做新约的仆役：这约并不是在于文字，而是在于神，因为文字叫人死，神却叫人活。

text_en: Now if the ministry of death, chiseled in letters on stone tablets, came in glory so that the people of Israel could not gaze at Moses’ face because of the glory of his face, a glory now set aside,
text_cn: 如果那以文字刻在石头上而属死的职务，尚且有过光荣──甚至以色列子民为了梅瑟面貌上易于消逝的光荣，不能注视他的面貌──

text_en: how much more will the ministry of the Spirit come in glory?
text_cn: 那么，属神的职务，岂不更该有光荣吗？

text_en: For if there was glory in the ministry of condemnation, much more does the ministry of justification abound in glory!
text_cn: 如果先前定罪的职务有过光荣，那么，成义的职务更该多么充满光荣！

text_en: Indeed, what once had glory has lost its glory because of the greater glory;
text_cn: 其实，那先前有过光荣的，因了这更超越的光荣，已算不得光荣了，

text_en: for if what was set aside came through glory, much more has the permanent come in glory!
text_cn: 因为如果那易于消逝的曾一度有过光荣，那么，这常存的更该多么有光荣！

text_en: Since, then, we have such a hope, we act with great boldness,
text_cn: 所以，我们既怀有这种希望，所以坦白行事，

text_en: not like Moses, who put a veil over his face to keep the people of Israel from gazing at the end of the glory that was being set aside.
text_cn: 不像梅瑟一般，将帕子蒙在脸上，免得以色列子民看到那易于消逝的光荣的终结；

text_en: But their minds were hardened. Indeed, to this very day, when they hear the reading of the old covenant, that same veil is still there, since only in Christ is it set aside.
text_cn: 但是他们的心意陷于迟钝，因为直到今天，在读旧约时，同样的帕子仍然存在，没有揭去，因为只有在基督内才得除去；

text_en: Indeed, to this very day whenever Moses is read, a veil lies over their minds;
text_cn: 而且直到今天，几时读梅瑟时，还有帕子盖在他们的心上；

text_en: but when one turns to the Lord, the veil is removed.
text_cn: 他们几时转向主，帕子就会除掉。

text_en: Now the Lord is the Spirit, and where the Spirit of the Lord is, there is freedom.
text_cn: 主就是那神：主的神在哪里，那里就有自由。

text_en: And all of us, with unveiled faces, seeing the glory of the Lord as though reflected in a mirror, are being transformed into the same image from one degree of glory to another; for this comes from the Lord, the Spirit.
text_cn: 我们众人以揭开的脸面反映主的光荣的，渐渐地光荣上加光荣，都变成了与主同样的肖像，正如由主，即神在我们内所完成的。
